bindings.label: Palpable lump in the left breast detected by patient
Patient is a 73-year-old female, otherwise healthy, with no relevant medical history of breast cancer

Physical examination revealed a 2.5cm elastic-hard, well-circumscribed, mobile mass in the outer quadrant of the left breast; no skin retraction, nipple discharge, or palpable regional lymph nodes; right breast was negative
Ultrasound shows a circumscribed oval mass with heterogeneous stiffness and high Emax, categorized as BI-RADS 4a
Histopathology reveals spindle cells with pleomorphic nuclei, positive SMA/vimentin/desmin/calponin/CD34, and Ki-67 15%
Pathology notes clear margins but cellularity and proliferative index preclude benign fibroadenoma
